newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-VASCO DIRECTOR ROBBED OF GATE RECEIPTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VASCO DIRECTOR ROBBED OF GATE RECEIPTS.

text.p: Vasco da Gama director Eurico Miranda said on Monday that he had been held up at gunpoint outside his home and robbed of his club's share of the gate receipts from their weekend game with Flamengo.

Miranda, one of the most controversial figures in Brazilian soccer, said he was confronted by two men as he arrived home on Sunday night and only realised it was a robbery when one of them fired a shot at him.
He said he was forced to hand over the equivalent of $65,000 which he was carrying back from the match at the Maracana stadium.
"I don't know if this was planned because it's not normal for me to bring the money home," said Miranda.
